input:
If truth values of statements p, q are true, and r, s are false, then the truth values of the following statement patterns are respectively

a : ~(p ^ ~r) v (~q v s)
b : (~q ^ ~r) <-> (p v s)
c : (~p v q) -> (r ^ ~s)

Options:
A. T, F, F
B. F, F, F
C. F, T, T
D. T, F, T

phase_1_understand_the_problem.problem_restatement: Evaluate three compound logical statements for p=T, q=T, r=F, s=F.
phase_1_understand_the_problem.key_observation: Compute each statement directly using truth rules for negation, conjunction, disjunction, implication, and biconditional.

key_formulas.implication_rule: T -> F is F; otherwise T
key_formulas.biconditional_rule: A <-> B is T when A and B have same truth value

phase_3_plan_the_approach.strategy: Substitute the truth values and simplify each expression one-by-one.
logical_steps: Step 4: Compare resulting tuple with options

step_1_evaluate_a.simplify: ~T v F = F v F = F

phase_5_verify_answer.verification: Each expression evaluates to false under the given assignments.
